hero.label: Made for Embedder
hero.headline: I want to help Embedder sell the future of firmware development.
hero.subheadline: Embedder is solving a real pain point for embedded engineers by replacing hours of datasheet reading and manual debugging with an AI agent that works on live hardware. That is a genuinely hard technical sell, which means the first BDR hire has to understand the product deeply and earn trust with skeptical engineers. I have done exactly that kind of consultative outbound work, and I want to do it here.

whyCompany.title: Embedder is attacking a workflow that has barely changed in decades
whyCompany.body: Firmware engineers have been flashing boards, reading datasheets manually, and debugging with external tools the same way for years. Embedder's agent closes that loop by generating drivers, flashing hardware, and running root-cause analysis in a single workflow. That is not an incremental improvement, it is a category shift, and that story is genuinely exciting to tell.

whyCompany.title: YC S25, freshly launched, first BDR hire: the timing is real
whyCompany.body: Embedder just launched its web platform and is moving toward a CLI agent mode that can test and debug hardware in real time. Ethan and the team are at the exact moment where pipeline creation becomes the constraint on growth. Being the person who builds that outbound motion from zero is a rare opportunity I do not want to pass up.

whyCompany.title: My BDR track record maps directly to what Embedder needs right now
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach and LinkedIn sequences that helped close 15 to 20 paying clients from scratch using HubSpot, which is precisely the zero-to-pipeline work a founding BDR does. Most recently at NextAfter I learned how to position technical B2B products to specialized audiences who are skeptical of hype. Selling an AI firmware agent to embedded engineers requires that same combination of structured outbound and credible product storytelling.

quote: Embedded software is one of the last frontiers that AI has not fully cracked yet, and Embedder is the most concrete attempt I have seen to actually close that gap on real hardware. I want to be the person who brings that story to the engineers who need it most.
